propositions: resolve_event_commit and resolve_position_commit omit --no-renames and -c log.showSignature=false, unlike the bulk map builders which carry both.
With log.showSignature=true on a host with signed commits, gpg: lines interleave into stdout so the last-line SHA parse returns a non-SHA value.
Adding --no-renames is behaviour-preserving because both pathspecs match at most one path and event renames are .json to .json.retired.
--no-merges must not be added because the fallback exists to catch files added only inside merge commits.
Both flags must appear in the argv of both resolvers while --no-merges must not.
Resolver output should match the bulk map builders over a sample of real events to confirm the flags do not change semantics.
